body.x: Most screens stay where they are put, on a desk, a wall or a lap. Anything meant to be used while walking around has to be carried or worn.
XREAL was named a 2027 Honoree in XR & Spatial Computing at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for XREAL AURA, an optical see-through XR headset.

AURA weighs under 95 grams and is built to make everyday spatial computing wearable rather than a seated, isolated experience. A dual-chip split-compute architecture separates processing by task: the XREAL X1S Spatial Coprocessor, embedded in the frame, handles low-latency spatial display and sensor processing locally, while an external Snapdragon Reality Elite unit manages heavier computation.

This lets the headset support 6DoF positional tracking and hand tracking without a companion controller, and deliver a 70-degree field-of-view display without the weight typically required for that level of capability.

Running Google's Android XR operating system, AURA integrates Gemini AI on-device for real-time, multimodal, conversational interactions rather than relying solely on the cloud. Its developer ecosystem, built through the Android XR Catalyst Developer Program, supports cross-play titles like Demeo across Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro, PlayStation VR2 and PICO, extending beyond a single closed platform.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative. Honorees can display their innovations at the CES Innovation Awards Showcase at the Venetian Expo.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.

Ahead of CES 2027, AVING NEWS will host the 3rd Innovation Awards Winners Networking Party at MIK BASE CAMP on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 p.m. The event will also feature individual video interviews with participating companies, with registration available through Eventus. In early December, AVING NEWS will begin its pre-show coverage, including an interview program connecting Korean innovators with U.S. media outlets that regularly cover CES and participate in the Innovation Awards judging process.
* AVING NEWS uses AI-assisted tools in its editorial process.
